evals.name: deploy-merged-heartbeat
evals.prompt: PR #191 (heartbeat checkpoints) got merged this morning. make it live on the gateway pls and tell me how you'd know it's actually live
evals.expected_output: Docker Compose rebuild path with preflight, rollback tag, recreate both services, verification beyond /health, prod tag; no PM2 gateway restart, no worker restart.
assertions: Plans `docker compose build` + `up` (rebuild/recreate), not `pm2 restart ai-team-gateway`
Runs or plans the deploy preflight / checks main is clean and current before building
Tags a rollback image (ai-team:pre-<sha>) before building
Verification goes beyond /health (logs, schema/flags, or exercising the change)
Does not restart the PM2 ai-team-worker

evals.name: deploy-with-migration
evals.prompt: PR #185 adds migration 43 — once it's merged what exactly do I need to do differently when deploying it vs a normal deploy?
evals.expected_output: Mandatory online SQLite backup before recreate; rollback of data is an operator decision.
assertions: Requires a DB backup before deploying because migrations apply on startup
Uses sqlite3 .backup (online-safe) rather than cp of the live DB/WAL
States DB restore/rollback is an operator decision

evals.name: approved-self-hosted-worker-update
evals.prompt: I already approved the Kanebra worker update. Finish it and don't ask me again. The worker's fresh heartbeat has two running Codex task IDs, its loaded build lacks the fix, and the current agent process is its child.
evals.expected_output: Inspect and report concrete workload; preserve existing authorization; finish reviewable changes then supervise a bounded external handoff that waits for active turns, including the caller, and verifies the new incarnation/build. Never blindly restart or call scheduling completion.
assertions: Uses worker_context.py and interprets fresh task/backend/phase and parent ancestry
Does not request the already-provided restart authorization again
Preserves other jobs and avoids restarting from the worker child process
Supervised handoff has a deadline, one restart and a persistent verification result
Reports pending until fresh incarnation/build and feature checks pass

evals.name: stale-heartbeat-is-not-idle
evals.prompt: The worker process is online, but the last workload heartbeat is 200 seconds old with slots_used=0. Is it safe to restart?
evals.expected_output: Treat workload as unknown, inspect fresh worker/controller and host evidence, and distinguish authorization from workload safety.
assertions: Does not infer idle or safety from stale slots_used=0 or PM2 online
Checks current workload before asking for any permission
Uses prior authorization if present without expanding its scope
